# Notice

A message about the page or a result: an icon, a word and a sentence on a status tint.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “alert”; HTML `<div role="status"> or role="alert" when urgent`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **icon**: Status glyph in the status text colour.
- **label**: The status word ("Error", "Sent").
- **message**: What happened and what to do.
- **action** (optional): A secondary button; its text turns neutral on the tint.

## Variants

- `info`:
- `success`:
- `warning`:
- `danger`:

## States

- `default`: Icon and word, not colour alone; a thick leading edge.

## Accessibility

- Role: status (polite) or alert (assertive)
- Only messages that need immediate attention are alerts.
- A saved inquiry, a sent mail and a delivered mail are different states and say so.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.1 Use of Color (A)
- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <div class="nd-notice" role="status">
    <span class="nd-notice__icon" aria-hidden="true">i</span>
    <div>
      <span class="nd-notice__label">Note</span> An informational message.
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nd-notice" data-status="success" role="status">
    <span class="nd-notice__icon" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
    <div>
      <span class="nd-notice__label">Saved</span> The inquiry is saved.
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nd-notice" data-status="warning" role="status">
    <span class="nd-notice__icon" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
    <div>
      <span class="nd-notice__label">Check</span> Some fields are optional.
      <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--secondary">
        Review
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nd-notice" data-status="danger" role="alert">
    <span class="nd-notice__icon" aria-hidden="true">×</span>
    <div>
      <span class="nd-notice__label">Error</span> The form was not sent.
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
